svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as provided in Sentence (2), nailing of
framing conforms to Table 9.23.3.4.
Where the bottom wall plate or sole plate of
an exterior wall is not nailed to the floor
framing to Table 9.23.3.4., the wall is
permitted to be fastened to the floor framing
by
(a) plywood, OSB or waferboard sheathing
extending down over the floor framing and
fastened to it to Article 9.23.3.5., or (b)
galvanized-metal strips 50 mm wide, not less than
0.41 mm thick, spaced not more than 1.2 m apart,
fastened at each end with at least two 63 mm
nails.
Where the 1-in-50 hourly wind pressure is 0.8
kPa or more, roof rafters, joists or trusses
are tied to the wall framing with connectors
that resist a factored uplift load of 3 kN.
Galvanized-steel straps 50 mm wide, not less
than 0.91 mm thick, fastened at each end with
at least four 63 mm nails are deemed to comply
with Sentence (3).
Table rows as printed in the Code, column headings shortened. Drawn: strips and strap on the outside face, sizes illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.23.3.4. (page 9-167)
